newsitem.title: INDIA: Festival buying boosts Indian sugar prices.
newsitem.headline: Festival buying boosts Indian sugar prices.

text.p: Festival buying, along with restricted supplies, helped in Indian sugar gains on Monday, dealers said.
"Increased consumer buying ahead of festivals coupled with restricted supplies helped the uptrend," one dealer said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 3/5 rupees to 1,260/1,283 rupees while M-30 gained by 15 rupees to 1,290/1,350 rupees.

Mill delivery rose by 10/15 rupees to 1,195/1,210 rupees on increased outstation buying. "Demand from neighbouring states remained high from local mills which in turn reduced sugar inflows from mills," he said.
